claims.text: Combining advanced free-energy sampling with machine-learning interatomic potentials can predict the melting properties of high-melting refractory materials.
The predicted properties include melting temperature, entropy of fusion, enthalpy of fusion, and volume change at melting.
The proposed approach significantly reduces computational cost relative to full ab initio thermodynamic integration.
The material must be represented in both solid and liquid phases near its melting point using DFT reference data.
An enhanced-sampling method using machine-learning potentials can replace ab initio molecular-dynamics thermodynamic integration.
Adequate DFT training data for both the solid and liquid phases are required.
The relevant free-energy landscape captures local structural ordering and anharmonic differences between solid and liquid phases.
Advanced free-energy sampling rapidly explores the phase space.
A machine-learning potential trained on DFT data reproduces DFT-level energetics.
Combining enhanced sampling with DFT-trained machine-learning potentials provides accurate solid–liquid free-energy differences.
Solid–liquid free-energy differences determine the melting temperature, fusion entropy, fusion enthalpy, and volume change at melting.
The proposed method will produce melting-property estimates in close agreement with full ab initio calculations.
The proposed method may reduce computational expense by approximately an order of magnitude.
Applicability depends on the availability of reliable DFT data for constructing the machine-learning potential.
Applicability depends on the enhanced-sampling method adequately capturing anharmonic effects near melting.
Performance may be limited for materials with extreme anharmonicity.
Performance may be limited when the machine-learning potential does not generalize across solid and liquid phases.
The transferability and high-temperature accuracy of the machine-learning potential are uncertain.
The degree of computational cost reduction across different refractory materials is uncertain.
